checks: new draw matches offline data; both editing entries are inside the candidate and no separate editor canvas remains
slider updates both projected band edges and candidate count without mutating the current round
real pointer dragging in the stereographic candidate matches the orthogonal grid edit; undo restores it
cancel discards the boundary draft and keeps the current record and metadata intact
confirm applies the boundary as a separate round with locks, notes and favourite retained
clicking a line removes it from both variants without deleting stars; undo, redo and cancel preserve the boundary
combined line and boundary edits survive confirmation, reload and exact JSON export/import
continuing boundary editing preserves prior line deletions
candidate editing fits 390px screens and every normal candidate retains its common display scale
deleting every line keeps all stars, reports isolated points and no longest edge, and persists after confirmation
generating with the slider records the chosen range and restores it after refresh
the preserved draw-8 round still imports without changing its stars, boundaries or sampling history

independentAudits.sampling: All integer widths 15..60, canonical recipes, cache isolation, final full-catalogue audit call sites and RA seam reviewed; no confirmed issue.
independentAudits.editing: Combined grid and line diffs, draft isolation, confirmation/cancel, replay, legacy manual-1 and pointer coordinate paths reviewed; no confirmed issue.

guarantees.sampling: The slider previews the angular half-width and initial candidate count. Generation uses and persists that width; final required bright stars may supplement the initial band.
guarantees.edit: Both editing modes use the candidate canvas. Confirm validates and saves a separate round; cancel restores the pre-session round.
guarantees.lines: Deletion affects both variants, retains all stellar members, can disconnect manual figures, and reports components/isolated points. Automatic figures remain connected.
guarantees.proof: Edited rounds remove automatic optimum certificates; unchanged local-first numerical proof scope remains fixed grid and protected ownership.

limitations: A known 55-degree sample, terrax-b1bxb1, did not prove the local-first optimum within the solver budget and was rejected. Slider limits do not guarantee success for every seed.
This is an initial sampling band, not a hard crop of final regional bright-star membership.
Multitouch, resizing during an active drag, and storage quota exhaustion were not exercised in the browser run.
scope: Independent constellation workbench; original stars and formal V1/V2 renderers remain unchanged.
